name: Anneliese Schmidt
bio:
Anneliese's fascination with aerodynamics began in her childhood, observing birds in flight and pondering the physics behind their effortless soaring. This curiosity led her to pursue a degree in aerospace engineering at RWTH Aachen University, where she excelled in computational fluid dynamics. After graduation, she spent several years working on civilian aircraft design, but her heart always yearned for the high-octane world of motorsport. She made the leap to Formula racing with a junior team, quickly impressing with her data analysis skills and ability to identify subtle aerodynamic improvements.

While relatively new to the role of Head of Aero, Anneliese brings a fresh perspective and a relentless drive to innovate. She believes in a collaborative approach, encouraging her team to challenge conventional thinking and explore unconventional solutions. Her calm demeanor and analytical mind make her adept at problem-solving under pressure, earning the respect of her colleagues. Anneliese's unique ability to translate complex data into practical, on-track performance sets her apart, making her a valuable asset in the pursuit of aerodynamic excellence.

Anneliese is determined to apply her technical skills to achieve success. Her goal is to become an influential female leader, using her experience to inspire the next generation of female engineers.

physical.description: Anneliese is of average height and has a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Drinks copious amounts of herbal tea throughout the day.
